# List

Rows of items with a leading icon or avatar and trailing meta.

- Status: implemented
- Category: container
- Pattern: HTML `<ul> / <ol>`
- Text style: `body` (`.nd-text-body`)

## Anatomy

- **item**: A row.
- **leading** (optional): Icon or avatar.
- **meta** (optional): Trailing tertiary text.
- **divider** (optional): Between rows.
- **state** (optional): An item holding a .nd-state for loading, empty or error.

## Variants

- `static`: Content only.
- `interactive`: Each row one link or button.

## States

- `default`
- `hover`
- `focus-visible`
- `loading`: Placeholder rows (skeleton, aria-hidden) keep the layout; the region is aria-busy and a status message says what is loading.
- `empty`: A sentence that says nothing matches or nothing exists yet, and what to do next; not an empty frame.
- `error`: The error glyph and a sentence that says what failed, with a way to try again; data already shown stays.

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Through interactive rows. |

## Accessibility

- Role: list / listitem
- Loading, empty and error are announced through a status region (role=status); the placeholder rows are hidden from assistive technology.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A)
- 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)
- 4.1.3 Status Messages (AA)

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-stack">
  <ul class="nd-list" role="list" aria-label="Example search results">
    <li class="nd-list__state">
      <div class="nd-state" data-state="empty" role="status">
        <p class="nd-state__title">
          No documents match “accessibility audit”
        </p>
        <p class="nd-state__body">Check the spelling or remove a filter.</p>
      </div>
    </li>
  </ul>
  <ul
    class="nd-list nd-list--divided"
    role="list"
    aria-label="Example documents"
  >
    <li class="nd-list__row">
      <span class="nd-list__body">Design foundations</span
      ><span class="nd-list__meta">Updated today</span>
    </li>
    <li class="nd-list__row">
      <span class="nd-list__body">Component reference</span
      ><span class="nd-list__meta">33 families</span>
    </li>
  </ul>
  <ul class="nd-list" role="list" aria-label="Example destinations">
    <li>
      <a class="nd-list__row" href="#component-button"
        ><span class="nd-list__body">Actions</span
        ><span class="nd-list__meta">View buttons</span></a
      >
    </li>
    <li>
      <a class="nd-list__row" href="#component-slider"
        ><span class="nd-list__body">Inputs</span
        ><span class="nd-list__meta">View sliders</span></a
      >
    </li>
  </ul>
</div>
```
